roll.10:
**27 Mar 2023:** Andrew had recently started a Financial Analyst job (around 20 Mar). He had no dog yet, loved animals—especially eagles—and enjoyed hiking; he recommended Fox Hollow. Audrey had dogs Pepper, Precious, and Panda, liked parks and trails, and shared dog photos.

**2 Apr:** Audrey’s household adopted small white puppy Pixie, who bonded with Pepper. Andrew was considering adopting but struggled to find a dog-friendly city home; Audrey suggested rental pet filters.

**16 Apr–3 May:** Andrew and his girlfriend explored city eateries, but he missed nature and weekly hikes, which soothed him. Audrey recharged outdoors with her dogs. Her dog-and-sunflowers tattoo represents her bond with dogs and love of nature. They shared baked goods and nature photos. Audrey’s dogs enjoyed hikes, fetch, and playdates; she used leashes and dog shoes.

**6–11 May:** Andrew searched shelters and pet-friendly housing near parks, seeking a dog suited to his lifestyle. Audrey road-tripped with her four dogs to national parks every couple of months. She planned a positive-reinforcement bonding workshop and opposed punishment; Andrew agreed and considered classes.

**2 Jun:** Audrey described a joyful dog outing and sunset hike to a national-park peak, with horses, breeze, and birdsong. Andrew remained discouraged about finding a suitable home and dog; Audrey offered to help if he emailed his criteria.

**13 Jun:** Andrew said a rock-climbing class with friends the previous Sunday got him hooked; as a beginner, he reached the top and shared climbing/view photos. Inspired to try kayaking and perhaps bungee jumping, he accepted Audrey’s invitation to walk her dogs on a wooded park trail. Her dogs usually walked about an hour, exploring at their pace; she shared photos of them running and playing frisbee in a meadow. Both found nature calming, joyful, and restorative.

**26 Jun:** Audrey had moved to a home with a bigger backyard her dogs loved; she set up an agility/play area. Andrew shared a photo of a nearby dog daycare with a large indoor play space; Audrey planned to check it out. Both saw pets as family and disliked people who hate or hurt pets. Andrew shared a neighborhood-park flower-bed photo and said he had hiked with friends the previous Friday, enjoying birdsong, tree scents, and nature’s peace. Audrey shared an old hike photo of friends at a beautiful mountain lake; she said the lake and nature calmed them and reminded them to appreciate life’s small things.

**3 Jul 2023:** Audrey was taking a challenging but rewarding dog-training course; her dogs were improving. Andrew still couldn’t find dog-friendly rentals and missed trails, though he was finding urban adventures and getting into cooking as a relaxing, creative hobby. Audrey hadn’t explored new trails much due to the course. She shared a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball and said her four dogs were all mutts: two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes, all 3 years old and a close-knit pack. They loved running and fetch; they’d had a fun, somewhat chaotic dog playdate the previous Friday. Audrey said the dogs were her universe and shared photos of dogs in a bed and on a couch.

Audrey loved cooking and offered Andrew recipes. Her favorite was family chicken pot pie, a long-standing recipe that reminded her of her grandmother’s kitchen and conversations at the table; she shared pie photos and promised to send it. Andrew was a cooking rookie, enjoying experimenting and using it to de-stress. Audrey liked cooking as an escape and creative outlet; she put on music, poured wine, and found it therapeutic/self-care. Garlic was her go-to ingredient. She offered her roasted chicken recipe, inspired by Mediterranean flavors: chicken, garlic, lemon, and herbs; she called it an easy, healthy favorite comfort meal and shared a photo of chicken and potatoes. Andrew was keen to try it and promised to report back.
roll.19:
27 Mar 2023: Andrew began financial analyst job ~20 Mar; loves eagles, animals, hiking; recommended Fox Hollow. Audrey has dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda (later says four dogs); loves trails/parks.
2 Apr: Audrey’s household adopted Pixie, who bonded with Pepper. Andrew wanted a dog but struggled to find dog-friendly housing.
Apr–Jun: Andrew missed nature while dating; tried climbing, wanted kayaking/bungee jumping, likes cooking. Audrey hikes/road-trips with dogs, uses positive reinforcement, offered housing help; moved to bigger yard/agility area; dog-and-sunflowers tattoo.
3 Jul: Audrey’s four 3-year-old mutts: two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes. Loves cooking (grandmother’s chicken pot pie; Mediterranean roast chicken); garlic go-to. Andrew beginner cook.
8 Jul: Andrew and girlfriend picnicked in nature (7 Jul); planned August dog-friendly hike with Audrey.
11 Jul: Andrew got German Shepherd puppy Toby; work kept him indoors. Audrey makes wooden pet tags; hoped dogs would meet.
27 Jul: Andrew and girlfriend volunteered at shelter (24 Jul). Audrey’s childhood dog Max loved fetch; describes dogs as relaxed/wise, playful, mischievous/cuddly, lively/adventurous.
4 Aug: Andrew, girlfriend, Toby camped. Audrey does agility twice weekly; says Shepherds smart/loyal.
16 Aug: Audrey has tattoos of all four dogs; prefers four so each gets attention. Favorite spots: Pepper couch, Pixie bed, Precious chair, Panda rug. Pets are family. Andrew/girlfriend visited vegetable farm.
19–24 Aug: Andrew took nature breaks, fished at nearby lake with girlfriend; wants to bond with Toby. Audrey groomed dogs after course, advises gentle patience; daily brushing/baths/nail trims. Andrew shared Toby photos; Audrey encouraged taking time.
6 Sep: Andrew stressed at work, takes coffee/lunch walks; seeks dog-friendly housing. Audrey encouraged daily self-care; had neighbor-dog playdate and bought beds; Andrew hiked, wants Toby to join when older.
24 Sep: Audrey’s dog broke leash at park; she caught and soothed her with hugs, pets, calm voice. Advice for bonding: patience, regular training, love, praise; practices sit/stay/shake/roll over; dogs walk multiple times daily. Audrey gardens, including veggie patch and easy-care Peruvian lilies (water/sun); dogs enjoy exploring garden and play only with her own dogs. Says dogs mean everything to her. Andrew shared balcony flowers.
roll.28:
27 Mar 2023: Andrew had recently started a financial analyst job. He loves eagles, animals, hiking, cooking, and nature. Audrey likes trails and parks, loves cooking (especially garlic), and makes recycled jewelry and wooden pet tags. Her dogs are family; she uses positive reinforcement and does agility with them.

Jul 2023: Andrew and his girlfriend got German Shepherd puppy Toby. 19 Oct 2023: They adopted shelter dog Buddy.

Audrey has four dogs: Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie. Favorite spots: Pepper—couch; Pixie—bed; Precious—chair; Panda—rug. On 28 Oct, she said Pepper and Panda are Lab mixes; Precious and Pixie are Chihuahua mixes. On 24 Oct she had a cast after an accident at a park.

28 Oct 2023: Audrey said her dogs had been acting unusually. She’d consulted an animal behaviorist the previous Wednesday and was changing their routine and using positive reinforcement, with some progress. Andrew shared hiking photos and invited her on a dog-friendly autumn hike near a lake, tentatively planned for Saturday, 4 Nov; no trail specified. Audrey was excited and hoped her dogs would be back to normal. Andrew had a picnic date with his girlfriend planned for Sunday.

4 Nov 2023: Andrew said he and his girlfriend had gone biking and found a park outside town; he shared a photo of two people biking on a paved path. Audrey said a recent park outing with her four dogs was fun and they got to run and get fresh air. She’d joined a dog owners’ group that met weekly for tips and dog play, and shared group-and-dog park photos. The outing may have been the previously planned one, but date/location aren’t confirmed.

Andrew considered another dog but worried Toby and Buddy were already a lot of work. Audrey advised focusing on their health and happiness; Andrew agreed. She said they didn’t need another dog to be happy, offered help, and shared a photo of two dogs playing frisbee. Andrew said he’d made city dog ownership work. Audrey said it was tough but doable with daily activity, socialization, exercise, and mental stimulation. She shared photos of an indoor toy basket, a dog fetching a tennis ball, and a dog playing frisbee indoors. Suggested puzzles, training, and hide-and-seek; Andrew said he’d try them. They affirmed their friendship and mutual support.

22 Nov 2023: Audrey said she’d taken her four dogs to a pet salon the previous Friday, 17 Nov. They were excited and wagged their tails; they took a while to settle but behaved well. She shared a grooming photo described as a dog standing on a table with a leash, and remarked on their shiny coats. Andrew said they looked great and asked if his dogs had been groomed; he said not yet, but soon.

Andrew said he had adopted another dog “the other day” and shared a photo described as a woman feeding a dog hay in a barn. They named the puppy Scout, chosen for its adventurous spirit. Andrew and his girlfriend planned to take Scout, Toby, and Buddy to a small nearby park. Audrey advised starting with small outings, gradually increasing exposure, and keeping Scout leashed; she shared a photo of a dog running with a tennis ball. Andrew said Scout would stay leashed while adjusting to outside, and that they had bought a bed, toys, and puppy pads to make a comfortable safe space. Audrey encouraged gradual introductions to Toby and Buddy. Andrew said they felt lucky to have Scout and asked how Audrey’s dogs were doing. She said they were doing great, exploring and meeting people, and felt loved and safe. Both described their dogs as family and a source of joy and friendship.

rebuild.10:
Andrew became a Financial Analyst the week of 2023-03-20. He loves animals but had no pet; he missed hiking with his family dog and sought a dog-friendly apartment, ideally near parks/woods, to adopt a small dog. By 2023-07-03 he was still searching. Nature restores him; he hikes most weekends, enjoys scenery, and has tried rock climbing (2023-06-11), with kayaking/bungee jumping in mind. Cooking became a stress-relieving hobby.

Audrey had dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda, and puppy Pixie (adopted by 2023-04-02); by 2023-07-03 she had four 3-year-old dogs, two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes. She enjoys dog walks, hikes, playdates, and nature. She moved to a larger house with a backyard by 2023-06-26, setting up agility gear. She uses positive reinforcement and attended a dog-training course/workshop. Her arm tattoo shows a dog and sunflowers.

Andrew and girlfriend tried a pastry café on weekend 2023-04-08/09. Audrey and Andrew discussed a future pastry party (no date/place). Audrey offered to help Andrew find housing (2023-06-02). They planned a dog walk after Audrey invited him (June 2023).

Audrey loves cooking; favorite is family chicken pot pie, and her garlic-lemon-herb roasted chicken is a comfort meal. She offered both recipes; Andrew planned to try them (2023-07-03).
rebuild.19:

Audrey is devoted to them; walks them, hikes, plays fetch, does agility (twice weekly by Aug), training, grooming, and playdates. Audrey loves nature, cooking (chicken pot pie family recipe; garlic roasted chicken), and gardening (Peruvian lilies/vegetables). She has dog-and-sunflower and four-dog tattoos. Andrew and Audrey planned an August hike with their dogs; no date/location recorded.
rebuild.28:
Andrew started a Financial Analyst job the week of March 20, 2023. He loves animals, especially eagles, and finds nature peaceful, restorative, and grounding. He tries to hike on weekends, enjoys mountain views and fresh air, and likes sharing nature photos. City life and work have often made it hard to get outdoors; he has looked for dog-friendly housing near parks.

Andrew’s dogs: Toby, a male German Shepherd, came home July 11, 2023; Buddy was adopted from a shelter by October 19; Scout was recently adopted by November 22. Andrew and his girlfriend named Scout for his adventurous spirit. They prepared a bed, toys, and puppy pads, kept Scout leashed outdoors, and Audrey advised gradual introductions to Toby and Buddy. Andrew has discussed hiking, grooming, training, and outdoor adventures with his dogs. He and his girlfriend enjoy cafés, food outings, board games, biking, fishing, wine tasting, and volunteering at a pet shelter (July 24, 2023).

Audrey has four mixed-breed dogs: Pepper and Panda are Labrador mixes; Precious and Pixie are Chihuahua mixes. They are all about three years old as of July 2023. Pixie joined the household April 2, 2023; Pepper needed time to adjust, but they became close. Audrey describes the dogs as family and says they bring her joy and comfort. They enjoy walks, hikes, fetch, frisbees, parks, and playdates. Audrey prioritizes their safety and wellbeing, uses positive reinforcement, puzzles and training, and has taken training, agility, grooming, and animal-behavior advice. She has tattoos of a dog with sunflowers and later all four dogs. She moved to a home with a larger backyard by June 26, 2023, and made an agility play area. She enjoys cooking (especially family chicken pot pie and garlic-lemon-herb roasted chicken), gardening, and making/selling jewelry from recycled materials; part of jewelry profits go to an animal shelter.

Andrew and Audrey repeatedly discussed hiking together with their dogs. They agreed to hike in August 2023, and later planned a dog-friendly lakeside trail for November; on October 25 they agreed to hike Saturday, November 4, with Audrey bringing snacks. They also discussed birdwatching (Audrey would check her schedule; Andrew would bring binoculars and a notebook) and biking near the river. Plans may not have occurred.

Other details: Audrey saw a hummingbird on a hike in late April 2023 and hiked to a national-park peak around May 26–June 1, enjoying sunset, breeze, and birds. She likes nature and once visited a mountain lake with friends. Andrew took a rock-climbing class June 11 and considered kayaking or bungee jumping. Audrey injured her arm at a park in mid-October and was wearing a cast October 24. She grows Peruvian lilies and vegetables. Andrew and his girlfriend planned a beach trip with Toby in November (October 1). Andrew first tried sushi in October 2023; Audrey recommended California or salmon rolls.
